title: computeRatio: MCP tool-response lines (source=mcp_tool) are PLUMBING OVERHEAD — subtract from net, not from gross
summary: SCAR-TISSUE GOTCHA for bench-metric computeRatio: lines with source=="mcp_tool" AND a usage field contribute to GROSS (they are counted in the all-lines sum) but must ALSO be summed separately and subtracted to produce NET. A common mistake is to skip mcp_tool lines entirely in the gross sum (wrong: gross becomes too low) or to forget to subtract them from net (wrong: net == gross). The correct formula: gross = sum ALL usage lines; mcp_overhead = sum only source=mcp_tool lines; net = gross - mcp_overhead. The cache_read_input_tokens on MCP lines can be very large (thousands) and dramatically inflates gross vs net — the ratio difference is the diagnostic signal.
